whatItIs: A private, VY-agnostic constant-product AMM (NO AMM fee) pairing ARBITRARY tokens — holds the 'second leg' of every V-DAO's liquidity (asset/V-DAO and V-DAO/V-DAO pools). Driven by VARO at T4 V-DAO launch (VARO seeds via addPool) and topped up via permissionless donate. The main ValinityDAX simultaneously holds the VY/V-DAO leg. Design (locked): NO LP TOKENS — liquidity permanently locked, seeded once, can only shrink/move via swaps; NO deposit/withdraw/remove path; no admin extraction (rescueTokens blocks pool tokens). Fee-on-transfer native — books reserves against actual balance deltas (Uniswap-V2 style; every V-DAO burns 0.7% between non-exempt parties). On-chain listing rule — a pool leg must be an admin-allowed asset OR a main-DAX-listed (VY-anchored) token. Least privilege — VARO holds only POOL_CREATOR_ROLE + (optionally) a swap-whitelist entry.

fundFlow.in: addPool seeds (POOL_CREATOR/ADMIN); swapExactIn input (swap-whitelisted); donate (PERMISSIONLESS, one-way add-only). All via _pullToken balance-delta (FoT-safe).
fundFlow.out: swapExactIn output -> caller-supplied `recipient` (value-conserving constant-product swap, k preserved exactly since no fee; gated onlySwapWhitelisted). rescueTokens -> admin `to` (non-pool tokens ONLY; isPoolToken guard blocks all pool reserves).
fundFlow.lockedLiquidity: There is NO withdraw/remove/extract path for pool reserves. Reserves can only grow (input leg + donate) or shrink via a value-conserving swap output. rescueTokens explicitly reverts on any isPoolToken. => pool liquidity is permanently locked; the only material drain vector is a malicious UUPS upgrade adding a withdraw path.
fundFlow.noArbitraryDrain: swapExactIn recipient is arbitrary but the caller pays input for output (no free value); donate cannot withdraw; rescue cannot touch pool tokens. CLOSED relative to roles.

audit.workflow: wvrnl84j3 (23 agents, 5 dimension finders -> adversarial verify -> synthesis). 24 raw -> 8 survived / 9 refuted / 7 Low-Info. Tally: 1 Critical, 3 Medium, 7 Low. ALL admin-trust/handoff or operational. ZERO permissionless-exploitable.
audit.verdict: CLOSED / liquidity permanently LOCKED relative to roles (proven by exhaustive path analysis). Pool reserves can leave ONLY via a value-conserving, whitelist-gated, k-preserving swapExactIn (no AMM fee => k=reserveIn*reserveOut preserved; out<reserveOut structurally; rounding floors in the pool's favor; out==0/<minOut revert). donate is one-way add-only (donor can't swap => no profit). rescueTokens reverts on any isPoolToken => admin can never pull pool reserves. NO LP token, NO deposit/withdraw/remove/collect/skim path. All externals nonReentrant; output transfer after reserve update (CEI). FoT-safe: input leg uses _pullToken balance-delta. Pools are ISOLATED (no shared basket, unlike main DAX). mainDax init-only immutable (= real ValinityDAX 0xD256C672).
audit.findings: C1 _authorizeUpgrade IS the liquidity-safety boundary (permanently-locked liquidity rests entirely on the impl; a malicious upgrade adds a drain -> all V-DAO reserves in one tx; no timelock; kept Critical for blast-radius consistency, workflow rated High). M1 updateSwapWhitelist rogue-swapper MEV (no pool drain; sandwich honest swappers/donors via no-fee swaps + permissionless donate; admin-trust; kept Medium, workflow High). M2 updateAssetAllowed poison-asset (contained to its isolated pool; nonReentrant + balance-delta + CEI defeat callbacks/standard-FoT; griefing/DoS not drain). M3 [NEW] output-leg fixed-decrement not balance-delta -> correct for recipient-side-FoT/no-FoT (all current tokens), would desync only for a non-standard sender-side/bidirectional-FoT token (gated by asset curation; subsumes the 'multi-swap compounding' + 'no runtime invariant check' Lows). Lows: L1 donate price-skew (no profit), L2 direct-transfer of pool token stuck (footgun), L3 creation-time-only listing (mitigated by setPoolSwapPaused), L4 dual-role migrate-both, L5 [NEW] donate has no pause guard (skew during pause, no value loss), L6 [NEW] addPool also callable by ADMIN (separation-of-duties), L7 [NEW/Info] no runtime reserve==balance assertion (off-chain monitor recommended).
audit.refutations: Workflow refuted 9 of 17 Crit/High/Med: reentrancy (nonReentrant on all externals); donor cannot profit from skew (not swap-whitelisted); rounding cannot drain (mulDiv floors in pool's favor, amountOut==0 rejected); swap cannot extract beyond constant-product; no admin pull of pool tokens without an upgrade (isPoolToken guard).
audit.handoff: Migrate DEFAULT_ADMIN+ADMIN together -> governance TimelockController + real upgrade delay, then renounce EOA (C1+L4 — the upgrade lever IS the liquidity boundary, strongest control required). Freeze swapWhitelist to the audited MEV bot only (M1). Curate assetAllowed to vetted recipient-side-FoT/no-FoT assets; never whitelist a sender-side-FoT token (M2+M3). mainDax init-only immutable (verified = real DAX). Run an off-chain reserve-vs-balance monitor (L7). Dependency: the V-DAO token must stay hook-free (audit at the VDAO factory/token audit).
